name: ADENTRA Inc.
summary: ADENTRA Inc. is a wholesale distributor of architectural building products serving residential, repair and remodel, and commercial construction in Canada and the United States. It sells doors, decorative surfaces, mouldings, hardwood lumber, plywood, composite panels and roofing to manufacturers, builder yards and home centers. Founded in 2004 as Hardwoods Distribution Inc., it is based in Langley, Canada and adopted its present name in December 2022.
